credit: The sign that ends a speed limit: a post with a plate on it, drawn facing north; the renderer turns it. It has its own texture, textures/block/track_speed_release.png, and no number is drawn over it, so both this model and that texture can be edited freely. Keep the plate where it is (from 2.5, 5, 7 to 13.5, 14, 9): the shape of the block is measured from it. The plate's two broad faces map the whole texture rather than the slice their own size would take.
